explanation.en: When the outcome is most uncertain: p(1 − p) = 0.25.

text.tr: Binom dağılımı neyi sayar?
text.en: What does the binomial distribution count?

tr: Sabit hızdaki olayları, deneme sayısı olmadan
en: The number of successes in n independent trials
Events at a constant rate, with no number of trials

explanation.en: A fixed number of independent yes–no trials.

tr: Başarıların hangi denemelerde olduğunu seçmenin yollarını
en: The ways to choose which trials succeed

explanation.tr: Her yolun olasılığı aynı: pᵏ(1 − p)ⁿ⁻ᵏ.
explanation.en: Each way has the same probability: pᵏ(1 − p)ⁿ⁻ᵏ.

text.en: What is the variance of the same binomial?

text.tr: Hangisi Poisson dağılımıyla en iyi anlatılır?
text.en: Which is best described by a Poisson distribution?

en: The number of e-mails arriving in an hour
The number of heads in 10 tosses
The time waiting for a bus

explanation.tr: Sabit ortalama hızda, bağımsız olayların sayısı.
explanation.en: A count of independent events at a constant average rate.

text.tr: Poisson(λ) için hangisi doğrudur?
text.en: Which is true of Poisson(λ)?

en: Its mean and variance are λ

tr: n büyük, p küçük ve np sabit
en: n large, p small and np fixed

text.tr: Hafızasızlık özelliği hangi dağılıma aittir?
text.en: Which distribution has the memoryless property?

explanation.en: Time already passed does not change the remaining wait.

tr: μ'ye göre simetrik bir çan eğrisidir
en: It is a bell curve symmetric about μ

explanation.tr: Ortalama, ortanca ve tepe değer aynı noktada.
explanation.en: Mean, median and mode are at the same point.

tr: Birçok küçük bağımsız etkinin toplamı normale yaklaşır
en: The sum of many small independent effects approaches normal
Because instruments are set that way
Because it is a special case of Poisson

explanation.en: Income is right-skewed and cannot be negative.

en: At random from a normal or uniform distribution with small variance
